title: Josh McDaniels: Drake Maye knows a hell of a lot more than he did last year at this time

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Josh McDaniels: Drake Maye knows a hell of a lot more than he did last year at this time
sources.description: "This offseason is different," McDaniels said. "Last offseason, we were just getting to know the language and learning how to operate within a system of offensive football."
